capabilities: Set note text width in pixels or percent
Adjust width with a live slider
Show the current width in the status bar
Toggle custom width on and off
disambiguation: Not a pane or window resizer; it only changes the text column width inside notes.
extras: Manual install needs main.js, manifest.json and styles.css placed in .obsidian/plugins/note-width-changer.
intentEvidence: Obsidian only lets you pick narrow (with big empty margins) or full width.
problem: Obsidian only offers a narrow readable line length with large margins or full width, with nothing in between.
summary: Slider-based control that sets the text width of all notes to any pixel or percent value.
